verses.text: Save me, O God, by thy name, And judge me in thy might.

segments.text: Save me, O God, by thy name,
And judge me in thy might.

verses.text: Hear my prayer, O God; Give ear to the words of my mouth.

segments.text: Give ear to the words of my mouth.

verses.text: For strangers are risen up against me, And violent men have sought after my soul: They have not set God before them. [Selah

segments.text: For strangers are risen up against me,
And violent men have sought after my soul:
They have not set God before them. [Selah

verses.text: Behold, God is my helper: The Lord is of them that uphold my soul.

segments.text: The Lord is of them that uphold my soul.

verses.text: He will requite the evil unto mine enemies: Destroy thou them in thy truth.

segments.text: He will requite the evil unto mine enemies:
Destroy thou them in thy truth.

verses.text: With a freewill-offering will I sacrifice unto thee: I will give thanks unto thy name, O Jehovah, for it is good.

segments.text: With a freewill-offering will I sacrifice unto thee:
I will give thanks unto thy name, O Jehovah, for it is good.

verses.text: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble; And mine eye hath seen my desire upon mine enemies.

segments.text: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble;

headings.text: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. Maschil of David; when the Ziphites came and said to Saul, Doth not David hide himself with us?
